question: Find the title and view count of the most popular post (by view count) among those linked to post ID 61217, along with the display name of its owner.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p."XCL_035", p."XCL_030", u."XCL_055"
FROM postLinks AS pl
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON pl."XCL_024" = p."XCL_026"
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
WHERE pl."XCL_023" = 61217
ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
LIMIT 1
